newsitem.title: THAILAND: All four bidders seen winning Thai IPP tender.
newsitem.headline: All four bidders seen winning Thai IPP tender.

text.p: All four bidders for Thailand's Independent Power Producers (IPP) stage II scheme to supply power to a state-run power generator from 2001 are set to take part in the project, an official said on Wednesday.
The four bidders were chosen by a selection subcommittee to jointly supply about 4,174 megawatts of power to the Electricity Generating Authority of Thailand (EGAT), an EGAT official told Reuters.
Final selection is expected to be approved by the EGAT board of directors next week, she added.
The four groups included BLCP Power Co, which is a joint venture between Banpu Plc, Loxley Plc, CRA of Australia and the British utility Power-Gen.
Another consortium bidding is led by Gulf Electric Co in partnership with Lanna Lignite, Mission Energy and another Thai firm.
ALso bidding is a consortium comprising Union Energy, a unit of Saha Union, Tomen Corp of Japan, and Imatran Voima Oy of Finnland.
The fourth bidder is BWII Power Co, a joint venture between Hemaraj Land adn Development PLc and U.S.-based Bechtel Inc. -- Bangkok newsroom (662) 652-0642
